notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, survey and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 2 simply supported 20-ft bays, W18X86 girders, one 12.5-ton pendant crane, on new rolled W-stub brackets welded to the existing W14X120 columns, with the rail, ties, bearings and end stops; the existing columns are checked with their existing load effects and the existing sidewall rod bracing takes the crane longitudinal forces. A direct flange saddle does not suit this rolled girder (the sized saddle leaves saddle-across-fatigue 2.17, flange-tie-flange 1.63 for the estimated tie demands): the paired flat bars bolt to the tie-side bearing stiffener, cut as one plate with its gusset extension past the flange tip (no weld at the gusset), the full-depth stiffener pair carrying the tie force into the girder. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

Lightest compact W within the sizing targets (ratio ≤ 0.85, deflections ≤ 0.9 of the limits): screening estimates, H1 top-flange interaction with the load-height LTB strength ratio 0.80, vertical deflection 0.44, lateral 0.35 and rail-head movement with twist 0.60 of their limits; flanges at least 10.5 in wide for the end bearing bolt gauge and the rail seat; lighter candidates rejected: 53 by flange width, 1 by sizing ratio; the next lighter, W27X84: flange 10.00 in narrower than the 10.50 in the details need. These are the configurator's screening estimates (a simplified model that ranks the catalog), not the final ratios: the calculation checks the section and reports its own ratios.

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
